_comment: HOW TO USE — Copy this file to ~/.config/press-console/stocks.json and edit. Each entry is keyed by `code`. To override a built-in default stock (e.g. correct its supplier cost), include the same `code` and only the fields you want to change. To add a NEW stock not in the built-in catalog, include all required fields. To delete a stock you don't carry, leave it OUT of your file (the built-in default still loads — to fully suppress a built-in, set its cost_per_unit to 0 and add the tag `_inactive`). After editing, restart the FastAPI server OR just refresh the operator UI — `shop_stocks()` re-reads on every /api/stocks call.
_optional_fields: parent_sheet (letter | letter-l | legal | ledger | ledger-l | 12x18 | 18x12 | 13x19 | 19x13 | sra3 | sra3-l)
tags (array of strings — used for filter chips and the cost panel; add '_cost_unverified' if estimate)
default_paper_size (PJL paper size code: LETTER, P12X18, P13X19, SRA3, LEGAL, LEDGER)

_tray_convention_in_defaults.TRAY4: heavy text + premium covers (posters, premium BC)
